_note: Singapore Green Plan 2030 pathways as anchor-year values (linear interpolation between anchors). The district receives its PROPORTIONAL SHARE of national rollout — never 'Singapore adds X here'. All values labelled: policy pathway assumption. EV charger targets (60,000 points by 2030) enter the model in M5 when the EV mode ships.

_sources.grid: EMA SES 2025: grid emission factor 0.402 kgCO₂/kWh (2024, VERIFIED; 0.412 in 2023). Trajectory anchored to EMA targets: 3 GWp solar by 2030 + ~6 GW low-carbon electricity imports by 2035 (~1/3 of supply). Base 402 → 300 gCO₂/kWh matches EMA 'imports-success' range 250-300 by mid-2030s.
_sources.car_fleet: LTA: all new car/taxi registrations cleaner-energy from 2030; fleet turnover ~7%/yr; extends the LTA-2025 fleet-weighted 144 gCO₂/pkm
_sources.bus: LTA: half of public bus fleet electric by 2030; e-bus ≈ 0.065 kWh/pkm × grid factor
_sources.cycling: Green Plan: ~1,300 km cycling paths by 2030 (island-wide, district gets proportional share)
_sources.lta_trend: Green Plan values except car EF, which follows the Bass curve fitted to LTA monthly EV fleet data (central ceiling 0.5; engine/helios_engine/energy/run_energy.py). Data-implied car EF falls faster than the target_achieved assumption.

derived._note: Computed in code, coupled to the year's grid factor
derived._diesel_note: Chosen so the 2026 blended bus EF ((1-0.06)*72.8 + 0.06*26.1) reproduces the V2 measured-mix value of 70 gCO₂/pkm
